name: b_edge2b
description: B-EDGE2b: three-armed breakout revalidation as the 15m store outgrows the API's ~52d retention. Frozen 2026-06-12 at store span ~52.3d (= the window every breakout number so far was measured on); min_span_days 60 gates the first rerun on genuinely new data (~Jun 20). Config lb=384/ex=96 (Iter 35); ER gate 0.1/96 (Iter 49). Taker arms only — optimistic maker fills are not promotion evidence for momentum.
decision: The promotion-relevant arm is combined-er-taker (the breakout_er_v1 configuration): it must keep PASSING G0 as samples lengthen or breakout_er_v1's promotion case dies. original-taker tracks whether the base edge's regime persists; breadth-taker is expected weak/FAIL — a breadth PASS would upgrade the thesis, a combined-er FAIL kills it. Remember the 0.1 ER threshold was selected on the 52d breadth sweep (Iter 49), so only post-Jun-12 data is out-of-selection. Rerun every few weeks as the store grows (bump min_span_days after each rerun so the next run waits for new data); promotion stays human-gated via B-PAPER3c.
